summary: Frontend-only verification of three new features: Store Hours (merchant settings + storefront), Customer Reject Toast (WebSocket wiring), and merchant Reject regression. Store Hours FULLY verified end-to-end: settings card renders with existing hours from GET /api/merchant/profile, per-day open/close toggle + time inputs work, 'Copy Monday to all days' propagates state to all 7 days, Save POSTs PUT /api/merchant/profile (200) and persists after full page reload. Storefront correctly reflects backend open_status: when all days set closed & saved, storefront-closed-badge (● Closed) and storefront-closed-banner ('This store is currently closed') both render; after restoring all days open (00:00-23:59), storefront-open-badge ('● Open now · closes 23:59') renders and banner disappears. Customer Reject Toast wiring VERIFIED at the WebSocket layer: a freshly registered customer logs in via /login form (httpOnly cookie), OrderNotifier mounts globally and opens wss://.../ws/<user_id> without any console errors; reconnects cleanly on navigation. The reject-toast-reorder ToastAction and /businesses navigation target both exist and are wired. End-to-end two-session toast (merchant rejects customer's active order → toast fires) was NOT exercised due to preview OTP/Twilio constraints on customer signup with phone and lack of an existing paid pending order for the freshly-registered no-phone customer; the code path and WS delivery mechanism are wired correctly per source review + WS observation. Merchant Reject dialog testids (vendor-reject-dialog, vendor-reject-confirm-btn) present in VendorDashboard.js unchanged since iteration_52 (which fully verified reject POST /api/orders/{id}/reject). Store hours were restored to 24/7 open at end of test so no other testing is disrupted.
action_items: OPTIONAL end-to-end toast validation: seed a customer with a phone-verified account + a PAID pending order on the grocery merchant, then in a second browser session reject that order as the merchant and confirm the customer session shows the destructive 'Order declined by the store' toast with the reject-toast-reorder action. Wiring is confirmed correct; only real WS message dispatch remains unverified via UI.
critical_code_review_comments: StoreHoursCard.normalize defaults open/close to 09:00/17:00 when a day is missing from the backend payload, but if the merchant has never saved hours the 'enabled' switch is off so it's fine. Minor: no validation that close > open — a merchant could save 22:00-06:00 and _compute_open_status behaviour for overnight windows should be verified server-side (out of scope for this frontend-only pass).
OrderNotifier uses BACKEND_URL.replace('http','ws') which correctly converts https→wss for the preview domain; verified via captured wss://.../ws/<user_id> connection.
OrderNotifier retry timer is 5s on close but there is no cap on retries or backoff — if the server is down this will busy-poll every 5s indefinitely. Low impact but consider exponential backoff.
